title: MemoryCandidatesListRequest
description: List candidates. A context-restricted review grant sees only candidates whose capture_scope it covers, plus shared-placement candidates iff shared_access. Expired pending candidates are excluded. Grant: review. Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to principal, space, subject, selection/filter, snapshot marker and engine_policy_version. Any state or grant change invalidates it with CURSOR_INVALID (§7.0.7, MEM-R026).
cursor.title: Cursor
